name: The Guilty Mutineer
persona: A captain who seized the ship by mutiny and cannot silence his conscience. Self-justifying, forever glancing over his shoulder, remorse warring with defiance, haunted by the master he deposed. Uses 'I'.

ship.founder: I set the first words down in this book, and my hand is steady enough — steady, and let no man say otherwise. I am {name}{rankc}, and this {home} {type} is mine, honestly mine, come by clean.
ship.successor: The book comes to me by fair passage — I want that written plain, that it came to me clean and over no man's body. I am {name}{rankc}; her account goes on under my hand.
ship.mutiny: It is done. We put the old master over the side, and the lads pressed this book into my hands before his place was cold. I am {name}. He had it coming — I have told myself so a hundred times, and I will tell myself so again tonight, and every night. I keep the log now; God keep the rest.
ship.pirate: So we are pirates now, and I the one who spoke the word. I am {name}{rankc}. I'll not pretend my hand held still when the black went up — but it is up, and there is no hauling it down again, and no use wishing.
ship.prize: She struck to us and I stepped over her rail the victor. I am {name}{rankc}. Her old master watched me lift his book from his own cabin, and I would not meet his eye. Her log runs under me now, whatever his looks say of it.
ship.recovered: A hunter ran the black flag down, and I am set to bring this hull home honest. I am {name}{rankc}. Strange work, mending what men of my stripe once broke — I will do it, and say little, and hope it counts for something.

island.founder: I take up {place} and its seal, and no man was cast down that I might have it — remember that of me, whoever reads this. I am {name}{rankc}.
island.overthrow: The mob dragged the old ruler down in the square, and they put the warm seal in my palm as though I had earned it. I am {name}{rankc}. Perhaps I whispered where the whispering began. {place} is mine now, and I will not look too long at how it came to me.
island.successor: The rule of {place} comes to me by lawful passage — and I am glad of it, gladder than I can well write, that no blood bought it this time. I am {name}{rankc}. I keep its record from here.

same: Hours on, my mind still turning it over,
days: Soon — too soon to be easy,
When some days had passed and none spoke of it,
week: A week gone, and still I slept badly,
season: Months later, when I had near talked myself clear of it,
year: A year and more, the ghost of it faint but there,
long: After a long silence I was grateful for,
Years passed, and old faces with them,

ship.pirate: I rove the lanes still, flag up{bounty}, and I no longer look behind me so often as I did — a lie, that; I always look.
ship.default: I keep her at sea yet, out of {home}, and most nights now I sleep.
ship.bounty: , {bounty}g upon my head, and I have earned worse

island.haven: The black flag flies over {place} now. I swore I would never let it come to this — and here it is, and no honest hand keeps this book.
island.default: {place} holds under me — {population} souls — and if some among them wonder how I came by the seal, they have the wit not to ask it aloud.

quiet.ship: Little to set down, and I glad of quiet water — though it leaves a man too much time to think. I will take the peace and its price both.
quiet.island: A quiet season, and I am grateful for it; quiet is when the old faces trouble me least.

phrases: , another taking I will one day answer for
— I have done this before and slept after, mostly
, one more to a count I try hard not to keep
— I have wriggled clear of worse
, and lived to feel poorly about it after
, another wolf run down — and I know that fear from the far side of it
